title: Tubettini and Mussels

media.caption: Remove the byssus (beard) from the mussels
Rinse thoroughly under plenty of water
Shift the position of one shell, sliding it forward with firm finger pressure until you feel a click
Insert a short knife, sliding it flush along the inside of the upper shell
Complete the knife's path around the inside of the mussel
Prepare a sauce with garlic, tomato and parsley
Add the pasta to the pan

healthBenefits.title: Rich in Vitamin B12
healthBenefits.text: Mussels are an excellent source of vitamin B12, essential for nerve function and red blood cell formation.

healthBenefits.title: High-Quality Protein
healthBenefits.text: Mussels provide lean, complete protein that supports muscle maintenance and repair.

healthBenefits.title: Omega-3 Fatty Acids
healthBenefits.text: Mussels contain omega-3s that support heart and brain health.

healthBenefits.title: Antioxidant Boost
healthBenefits.text: Ripe tomatoes supply lycopene and vitamin C, which help combat oxidative stress.

healthBenefits.title: Heart-Healthy Fats
healthBenefits.text: Extra virgin olive oil offers monounsaturated fats that support cardiovascular health.

healthBenefits.title: Iron and Zinc Source
healthBenefits.text: Mussels are rich in iron and zinc, supporting immune function and energy metabolism.

_ingredientsText:
350 gr tubettini pasta (little tubes) 
1 kg of mussels 
1 clove garlic 
2 ripe tomatoes
2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil 
1 tablespoon parsley, chopped
salt 
pepper (optional)
_preparationText:
1 - togliere il bisso
2 - sciacquare con abbondante acqua
3 - spostare la posizione di una valva traslandola in avanti con una certa pressione delle dita fino a sentire un click
4 - Infilare un coltellino corto facendolo scorrere aderente all'interno della valva superiore
5 - Completare il giro del coltellino all'interno della cozza
6 - Aprire le valve
7 - Staccare il frutto della cozza
8 -  i frutti sgusciati a crudo
9 - Preparare un sugo con aglio, pomodoro e prezzemolo
10 - Aggiungere le cozze
11 - Aggiungere la pasta in padella
12 - guarnire con prezzemolo in foglie
